"""Record the documentation assertion repair without relabeling engine evidence."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = Path('<repo>')
TEST = 'shardloom-contract-tests/tests/release_readiness_metadata.rs'
DOC = 'docs/getting-started/first-10-minutes.md'

def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())

prior_path = REPO / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-typed-reductions-first-steps-repair-2026-10-05.json'
prior = read(prior_path)
assert prior['status'] == 'passed_local_hosted_recheck_pending'
assert prior['doc']['sha256'] == sha(REPO / DOC)
assert prior['native_documented_command_replay']['distinct_output_paths']
assert prior['native_documented_command_replay']['earlier_output_preserved']
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip()
assert base == '48098aeb7076c9b71f88e566ccfbe32863be2df4'
diff = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', TEST], cwd=REPO, text=True)
assert len([line for line in diff.splitlines() if line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++')]) == 3
assert len([line for line in diff.splitlines() if line.startswith('-') and not line.startswith('---')]) == 1
gates = {}
for name in ('first-steps-metadata-contract-tests-1', 'first-steps-metadata-contract-clippy-1',
             'first-steps-metadata-fmt-1'):
    path = OUT / f'{name}.json'
    receipt = read(path)
    log = path.with_suffix('.log')
    assert receipt['status'] == 'passed' and receipt['returncode'] == 0
    assert sha(log) == receipt['log_sha256']
    gates[name] = {'receipt_sha256': sha(path), 'receipt': receipt, 'log': log.read_text()}
test_log = gates['first-steps-metadata-contract-tests-1']['log']
passed = sum(int(n) for n in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed;', test_log))
assert passed == 171
failure = OUT / 'pr-1518-baseline-tests-job-4.log'
failure_text = failure.read_text()
assert 'first_ten.contains' in failure_text and 'target/generated-reference.jsonl' in failure_text
build = read(OUT / 'build-13.json')
runtime = {name: digest for name, digest in build['source_hashes'].items()
           if name.endswith('.rs') or Path(name).name in ('Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock')
           or name.startswith('python/src/')}
changed = {name: {'accepted_sha256': digest, 'current_sha256': sha(REPO / name)}
           for name, digest in runtime.items() if sha(REPO / name) != digest}
assert set(changed) == {TEST}
assert sha(build['binary']) == build['binary_sha256']
report = {
    'schema_version': 'shardloom.first_steps_metadata_repair.v1', 'status': 'passed_local',
    'failed_hosted_head': base, 'failed_run': 37346952046, 'failed_job': 111887800069,
    'cause': 'A Rust metadata assertion still required the retired fixed output path after the guide began using a fresh owned temporary directory.',
    'correction': 'Require the temporary-directory construction, declared JSONL filename and native write(output) call.',
    'preceding_native_document_replay': {'path': str(prior_path), 'sha256': sha(prior_path)},
    'unchanged_document_sha256': sha(REPO / DOC),
    'hosted_failure': {'sha256': sha(failure), 'relevant_lines': [line for line in failure_text.splitlines()
        if any(marker in line for marker in ('first_ten.contains', 'target/generated-reference', 'panicked at', 'test result:', 'FAILED'))]},
    'contract_test_source': {'path': TEST, 'sha256': sha(REPO / TEST), 'source': (REPO / TEST).read_text()},
    'contract_test_diff': diff, 'gates': gates, 'passed_contract_tests': passed,
    'accepted_binary_sha256': build['binary_sha256'],
    'unchanged_runtime_source_hashes': {name: digest for name, digest in runtime.items() if name != TEST},
    'changed_metadata_test_only': changed,
    'runtime_implementation_changed': False, 'binary_rebuilt': False,
    'hosted_recheck_pending': True, 'publication_attempted': False,
    'producer': {'sha256': sha(__file__), 'source': Path(__file__).read_text()},
}
text = json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
for old, new in ((str(REPO), '<repo>'), (str(OUT), '<evidence>'), (str(Path.home()), '<home>')):
    text = text.replace(old, new)
path = REPO / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-typed-reductions-first-steps-metadata-repair-2026-10-05.json'
with path.open('x') as stream:
    stream.write(text + '\n')
assert read(path)['passed_contract_tests'] == 171
print(json.dumps({'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(path), 'passed_contract_tests': passed}))
